entries.name: Timere — front
entries.description: Corps de Timere, sept animations ; silhouette adaptée aux consignes HD-2D.
limitations: Découpage, boucles et anatomie des six pattes à revoir.
entries.prompt: Recovered generation: six columns and seven animation rows, counts 5/4/6/4/4/5/6; dark green amorphous Timere body, long neck and tooth-lined mouth, six crab legs, ivory claws, pixel art, transparent background, strict front direction. Exact original prompt was not persisted before interruption.
